steps.code:
# Get all existing venmo friends by paginating
venmo_token = venmo_login['access_token']
all_friends = []
page = 0
while True:
    result = apis.venmo.search_friends(access_token=venmo_token, page_index=page, page_limit=20)
    if not result:
        break
    all_friends.extend(result)
    if len(result) < 20:
        break
    page += 1
print(len(all_friends))
print(all_friends)
